Type: rug
Name: Stone & Beam Medallion-Patterned Rug, 5' x 8', Red and Steel Blue
Materials: steel
This transitional rug boasts a multicolored pattern with a handstitched binding that adds elegance to any room. The soft, thick pile gives it a luxurious feel, great for tired feet. Durable nylon helps prevent wear and tear, keeping the rug looking beautiful. 5'W X 8'L Pile: 100% nylon; back: 100% cotton This durable nylon rug has a handstitched edging. A low pile makes this rug especially practical for outdoor use or high-traffic areas. Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
